dispatch.press:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE - November 27, 2026

Martin Strayd Drops Raw Alt-Rock Confession: "Adhd I Can Do That (Travillen Disorder)"

Australian artist Martin Strayd unleashes a candid slice of alternative rock with "Adhd I Can Do That (Travillen Disorder)" now streaming on Apple Music. The track captures the chaotic energy of navigating a brain that runs on multiple frequencies at once. With crunching guitars and a relentless rhythm, Strayd turns his neurodivergent experience into an anthem of self-acceptance. The title itself is both punchline and defiance, a reclaiming of limitation through sheer willpower. Stream now at the artist portal.

Strayd has built a catalog spanning alternative, reggae, blues, rock, and soundtrack work. His 365-day daily single mission keeps fans guessing with fresh material landing regularly. Listeners who purchase MP3 and cover art bundles own them outright and can share freely with friends.
